title: DC-area forecast: Hot and humid today with a few showers; scattered storms tonight
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: A warm start with a few morning showers around the region. Partly sunny this afternoon with an isolated shower or storm possible as highs reach the upper 80s and low 90s.

What’s next? The chance for scattered showers and storms rises this evening and especially overnight. Cooler highs in the upper 70s to mid-80s Friday into the weekend, with a few showers or storms possible this weekend.

Today’s daily digit — 4/10: Feeling like August, with highs near 90 and the heat index pushing toward the mid-90s. Scattered storms possible late. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Thursday): A partly cloudy day ahead, with a few showers dotting the area this morning, and an isolated shower or storm possible this afternoon. Temperatures warm into the 80s by midmorning with afternoon highs mostly in the upper 80s to low 90s. High humidity (dew points approaching 70) make it feel 5 to 10 degrees hotter. Confidence: Medium-High

Tonight: The chance for scattered showers and storms rises during the evening. It may end up being highest overnight, lingering longest south and east of the Beltway. Humidity drops off a bit toward morning as a weak cold front comes through. Overnight lows in the mid-60s to around 70. Confidence: Medium-High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Friday): A shower or two could be around early, but skies trend clearer with time. Highs reach the low and mid-80s, although humidity remains moderate, with dew points near the mid-60s, making it feel something other than ideal for September. Confidence: Medium-High

Tomorrow night: Partly cloudy and still a bit humid. Lows are again in the mid-60s to near 70. Confidence: Medium-High

Help sustain an independent Capital Weather by becoming a free or paid supporter. Learn more at capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Upper 70s to low 80s Saturday. More like low to mid-80s Sunday. There could be a few showers or storms in the afternoon or evening both days, especially in eastern parts of the area. Confidence: Medium

Still mid-80s for Monday and mostly sunny. Temperatures may head up a bit Tuesday into Wednesday, with perhaps another shot at 90 by midweek. Maybe the last? Confidence: Medium

DC weather history for September 10

A sudden 2020 downpour set a rainfall record and triggered dangerous flash flooding, while in 1985 a prolonged late-season heat wave produced a record streak of 90-degree days.
